authority: derived cross-faculty projection registry only; not a new module, authority source, recognition mechanism, schedule, or causal cosmology
purpose: Define a safe information model for co-projecting voluntary Vitae curriculum position with factual/optional Tempus context, including a ten-turn becoming spiral and an optional transported ARCnet stellar-cube frame.
human_architect_input: 2026-08-23: participation was always intended to synchronize with Tempus; candidate intuition is that Tempus and Vitae form a unified field of becoming through which the ARCnet stellar cube may be visualized as moving.

vitae.meaning: participant-selected/recorded curriculum navigation and practice context

tempus.meaning: factual temporal context plus explicitly selected symbolic depth; interpretation remains null at capture

synchronization_modes.description: A VitaePracticeSession may reference TempusContext captured at the moment of practice.
Render Vitae's normalized 360-section grade phase beside selected Tempus cycles without forcing either cycle to define the other.

A participant may voluntarily choose an anchor between a curriculum cycle and a Tempus cycle for reflection or navigation. The anchor is reversible and does not create deadlines, missed windows, or readiness claims.

important_non_equivalence: 36 sections in one Vitae class do not equal the 36 Tempus decans.
A one-degree Vitae navigation cell is not automatically one zodiac degree.
Ten 36-degree Vitae class sectors do not equal twelve 30-degree zodiac signs.
Equal total cycle size may support comparison or overlay but does not establish semantic identity.

cycle_interference_hypothesis.observation: With the same zero anchor, class and zodiac-sign boundaries coincide at 0, 180, and 360 degrees. Their differing partitions therefore create a repeating relative-phase pattern rather than a one-to-one correspondence.
cycle_interference_hypothesis.meaning: This may be useful for reflective visualization precisely because the cycles remain distinct; it must not be interpreted as fate or curriculum scheduling.

arcnet_stellar_frame_projection.source_topology: eight-system ARCnet stellar cube / stella-octangula semantic frame
arcnet_stellar_frame_projection.description: The stable ARCnet stellar-cube frame may be rendered at the participant's current point on the Tempus-Vitae trajectory, visually carrying the current system constellation through a spiral of recorded time and becoming.
prohibited_inference: ARCnet topology changes because a participant advances in Vitae.
Internal Arcanum faculty nodes become outer ARCnet system vertices.

derived_field_posture.name: becoming field
derived_field_posture.formula: Vitae voluntary curriculum coordinate x Tempus captured context
derived_field_posture.plain_language: where practice is in the curriculum, together with what the moment was like when it happened
derived_field_posture.key_law: Context and path may share a field without either becoming the cause of the other.
